description: This file defines a custom dialog builder class for Android that extends MaterialAlertDialogBuilder to create a branded delete confirmation dialog with customized button styles.

classes.name: DeleteAlertDialogBuilder
classes.description: A custom dialog builder that applies branding styles to positive and negative buttons in a delete confirmation dialog.

methods.name: DeleteAlertDialogBuilder
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the dialog builder with a context.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates the AlertDialog, applies branding, and sets a listener to reapply branding when the dialog is shown.

methods.name: applyBrand
methods.description: Applies specific branding styles to the positive and negative buttons of the dialog.
